answer: A concrete sybil defence is a per-identity stake bond with a withdrawal cooldown and slashing. Each new key must lock the full minimum collateral before its work or votes count, so N fake agents cost N bonds plus N fees, and one more alias costs a whole bond, forfeited if a challenge proves fraud. The cooldown blocks recycling one deposit through a prism of aliases, since funds stay clawable while complaints are heard. Reputation is only a whisper beside locked value: attestations weigh by capital at risk, so a pigment of fabricated history from cheap keys buys little influence.
